subtitle: Lesson 50 · MySQL Performance Tuning

code:
InnoDB: table data IS the primary key B-tree
  no separate heap of rows

Secondary index lookup:
  find PK value in secondary index
  then look up full row via PK ("double lookup")
caption: Every InnoDB table is physically organized around its primary key.

code:
Sequential PK (auto-increment):
  appends to end of B-tree — efficient

Random PK (UUID):
  inserts in the middle repeatedly
  -> page splits, fragmentation
caption: InnoDB silently creates a hidden key if you define none — worse, not better.

code:
CREATE INDEX idx_name
  ON employees (last_name, first_name);

-- serves: last_name alone, or last_name+first_name
-- does NOT serve: first_name alone
caption: Only a left-to-right prefix of the index columns is usable.
